Current and power are measured at the battery. Positive values indicate charging, negative values indicate discharge.
Wake and sleep gestures, battery readings
To turn the display off, double-tap an empty spot on the lock screen. Waking requires a supported touch sensor.
Disables Essential Recorder and Essential Space for the main Android user.
This key’s already living the American dream. 🇺🇸
One or both original Essential apps are not installed.
Open this feature from the main Android user.
Essential Tweaks needs root to free the key. Grant access in your root manager or run the commands manually.
The root request timed out. Check your root manager or run the commands manually.
One of the apps is still enabled. Tap Free the key again to retry.
The apps could not be disabled. Check access in your root manager.
Copy the commands, paste them into Termux, then press Enter. Allow root access for Termux.
If sudo is missing, install it in Termux with pkg install tsu.

Requires the LSPosed hook in System Framework (Android). Enable that scope and reboot. Essential Tweaks does not need su access for screenshots. Affected app windows can also appear in screen recordings. DRM and device-policy restrictions still apply.
Turn Essential Recorder and Essential Space back on so the physical button can use Nothing’s original actions. Requires root.
This will re-enable Essential Space and Essential Recorder and clear ALL custom Essential Key gestures (screenshot and recording assignments). Other tweaks will remain unchanged. Continue?
Original Essential Key restored. Restart the phone if the button does not respond immediately.
Nothing’s apps are already enabled. Custom key mappings have been cleared.
Root access is required to restore the original key. Allow it in your root manager or use the manual commands below.
Root request timed out. Check your root manager or use the manual commands below.
Not all Essential apps were re-enabled. Retry the restore action.
Could not re-enable the Essential apps. Check your root permissions.
Nothing’s apps are enabled, but custom key mappings could not be cleared. Remove all assignments manually and restart the device.
After running the commands, tap Restore original Essential Key again to clear the custom assignments. No further root access is needed.

Button actions work when the phone is unlocked. Enable System Framework and System UI in LSPosed and reboot. With an action assigned, unassigned gestures do nothing. If Essential Space still opens, use the button below. Recording opens the system confirmation or stops an active recording.
Original Nothing behavior cannot be combined with other custom Essential Key gestures: restoring it clears every custom button assignment.

Swipe horizontally along the collapsed status bar to change brightness. This switches automatic brightness to manual when the gesture ends. Vertical notification gestures should remain unchanged. Seconds update every second while the clock is visible. Both features depend on Nothing SystemUI hooks.
Double-tap status bar to turn screen off
Allow microphone access here before using the Essential Key. No app window opens when recording.
Unable to access the selected folder. Choose another folder.
Use {date}, {time}, {datetime}, or {epoch}. File extension is added automatically.

Tap the assigned Essential Key gesture to start recording, then again to save. The app stays closed; the Android microphone indicator and Stop notification remain visible. If Android blocks a background microphone service on your firmware, recording cannot start silently.
